_comment: R1 scripted rc controls, R0 config (RngRun 1, outageThreshold -1000): IMSIs 1,2 start on cell 3 (gNB 3), IMSIs 3-6 on cell 2 (gNB 2). via = the E2 node whose agent receives the control (1 = the eNB (MN), 2 and 3 = gNB agents); key = N5 cell key %08X%02X. Within a step the list order is the send order; the pacer sends the next control only after ns-3 reported controlRx for the previous one, so each agent's ctlIds are fixed. ns-3 applies a step's controls in C4 order (imsi, viaNodeId, targetCellId, ctlId). Case (b): target 3 (the UE's own cell) is sent FIRST: by arrival order it would be refused alreadyOnTarget and target 2 applied; by C4 order target 2 is applied first and target 3 then sees the UE in handover (inHandover), so the cause proves the sort. Case (c): node 3 is sent first for the same reason (C4: the lower nodeId, 2, wins). Each IMSI is used in one step only.

faultStop._comment: Fault run (ii): one ordinary control at step 20 (so 'no ledger line for the stop control' is not judged on an empty ledger), then a control sent after the final barrier through the eNB agent (node 1). ns-3 stops its emitters in the order 1, 2, 3 and, after `stopping`, reads only the pacer; the pacer holds endAck until agent 1 has forwarded the control, so ns-3 never reads it and agent 1 fails it on bye: exactly one RICcontrolFailure, no ledger line.
